query: What signals suggest an expense will be declined?

per_column.name: missing_source_id
per_column.rationale: Absence of a source id is a plausible data-quality signal available at or before decision time and lies outside the outcome.

per_column.name: missing_processed_date
per_column.rationale: Whether a processed date exists is tightly coupled to whether/how the expense reached a terminal state; it is largely determined by the outcome-processing step rather than being an independent pre-decision predictor.

per_column.name: is_pending
per_column.rationale: Derived from the same 'state' field as the focus; pending vs declined are mutually exclusive states, so this restates/partitions the outcome variable rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: is_submitted
per_column.rationale: Also a decode of the 'state' field. Being in another state category is a component of the same outcome variable, not an external predictor.

per_column.name: is_it_department
per_column.rationale: Department is a legitimate ex-ante attribute plausibly correlated with decline rates and independent of the outcome.

per_column.name: is_travel_category
per_column.rationale: Expense category is known before adjudication and can carry signal about decline likelihood.

per_column.name: amount_is_low
per_column.rationale: Thresholded amount is a pre-decision feature plausibly related to decline (small amounts auto-approved).

per_column.name: amount_is_high
per_column.rationale: High-amount flag is an ex-ante predictor plausibly linked to scrutiny and decline.

per_column.name: processing_delay_days
per_column.rationale: Computed from processed_date, which is post-adjudication; the 999 sentinel coincides with missing processed date and thus encodes the outcome. Not knowable before the decision.

per_column.name: risk_score
per_column.rationale: An engineered composite risk indicator; if built from pre-decision attributes it is a legitimate predictor, though its provenance is opaque and could hide leakage. Judged conservatively as a predictor.

judge.rationale: The set is a mix. Genuine ex-ante predictors (department, category, amount thresholds, missing_source_id, and a composite risk_score) provide real, if modest, predictive leverage on decline. However several columns undermine the claim: is_pending and is_submitted merely decode the same 'state' field the target comes from (restatement/partition of the outcome), and missing_processed_date / processing_delay_days derive from processed_date, a post-decision timestamp whose sentinel value coincides with unprocessed items — classic leakage. Because a meaningful fraction of the added columns restate or leak the focus, overall independent predictive utility beyond the original columns is moderate.
